scope.selectionMethod: case-insensitive exact text comparison against stateProvince; no point-in-polygon or source locality interpretation
scope.sourceStatus: coarse regional candidate queue only; review source-locality text and a versioned administrative boundary before assignment
scope.coverageLimit: This national OBIS slice covers one fish class only and is a marine/estuarine discovery feed. It is not a CALABARZON freshwater checklist or complete regional inventory.
scope.safetyLimit: No coordinates or individual locality strings are emitted in this report. Point precision and sensitive-species review remain required before any public map use.
scope.occurrenceStatusLimit: OBIS occurrenceStatus values are summarized as received and are not interpreted as presence; this slice contains missing and taxon-identifier-like values.
scope.habitatLimit: Provider marine/brackish flags may overlap and do not establish waterbody type or local salinity.
